purpose: Discoverable game memory variables with safe source-derived resolution and strict training gates
privacy: Only source-derived static addresses and relative offsets may be committed; no raw RAM, ROM, savestates, per-run heap addresses, raw vectors, local private paths, secrets or personal identifiers
scope: RSPE01 US revision 1; never assume offsets apply to other revisions
agents: S001–S005: every new, changed, rejected or disproven game-memory variable must be recorded here in agent PR with evidence, controls, owner, type, source, phase and training gate. Coordinator S000 handles contract conflicts.
